"''I can't''—|Ciena Ree tries to save JA189, but is too late|''[[Lost Stars]]''}} '''JA189''' was a [[Imperial Starfighter Pilot|TIE fighter pilot]] who served the [[Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Hoth]], JA189 and three other [[pilot]]s were sent into the [[Hoth asteroid field|Hoth asteroid belt]] to chase down the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]''. Imperial [[Lieutenant Commander]] [[Ciena Ree]] helped coordinate the four pilots from on board the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] ''[[Executor]]'', but even with her aid all four [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter]]s crashed within the belt while chasing the ''Falcon''. JA189 was the second to crash. ==Biography== {{Quote|Well done today, Lieutenant Commander."
"But— I lost all four pilots, sir."
"They had no chance, really. You kept them alive longer than they could have made it on their own.|Piett praises Ree for aiding JA189 and the other pilots|}} [[File:JA189TIEFighter-TESB.png|thumb|left|250px|JA189's TIE fighter was destroyed.]] JA189 was the designation of a [[human]] [[Imperial Starfighter Pilot|TIE fighter pilot]] who served in the [[Imperial Navy]] of the [[Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. JA189 was stationed on board an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]], when it traveled to the [[Hoth system]] as part of an [[Battle of Hoth|attack]] on the [[Echo Base|Rebel Base]] located on the [[planet]] [[Hoth]]. The Empire successfully defeated the Alliance on the surface of Hoth, but a large number of the Rebels escaped the planet in [[transport]]s protected from the Imperial [[fleet]] by an [[V-150 Planet Defender|ion cannon]]. Following the conclusion of the battle, the [[Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] demanded that at least three of the six ''Imperial''-class [[Star Destroyer]]s present for the battle, chase and capture one Rebel [[Starship|vessel]] in particular, the [[YT-1300 light freighter]] named the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]''. The ''Falcon'' fled from the Imperials into an [[Hoth asteroid field|asteroid belt]] located in the Hoth system in the hopes of hiding from them there. As the Star Destroyers were unable to give chase in the belt, JA189 and three other TIE [[pilot]]s were dispatched from one of the Destroyers and gave chase in [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter]]s, despite entering such a [[Asteroid field|belt]] in an unshielded craft being tantamount to [[Death|suicide]]. [[Lieutenant Commander]] [[Ciena Ree]] provided auxiliary [[Navigator|navigational]] assistance for the four [[pilot]]s from onboard the [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] of Vader's personal [[flagship]], the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] ''[[Executor]]''. Despite her assistance, the TIE pilot [[CR978]]'s vessel collided with an [[asteroid]] and exploded. Moments later, Ree gave warning that JA189's [[computer]] was not linking up, but was too late, as a small asteroid clipped JA189's [[TIE series|TIE]] and caused it to spin out of control and then explode, [[Death|killing]] the pilot. The two remaining pilots, [[OL701]] and [[Penrie|NA811]], soon suffered a similar fate to JA189, and the ''Falcon'' ultimately escaped Imperial clutches. Ree was deeply disheartened by the deaths of the four pilots, but was congratulated for her work helping them by [[Admiral]] [[Firmus Piett]], the commanding [[officer]] of the ''Executor''. Piett believed the four pilots had never stood a chance anyway, and that Ree had managed to keep them alive longer than they would have survived on their own. ==Behind the scenes== JA189's TIE fighter first appeared in the original release of [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']] in [[1980]], although the pilot was not visible in the film. JA189 was first identified and heard in the novel ''[[Lost Stars]]'', which was written by [[Claudia Gray]] and released in [[2015]]. In the [[2022]] non-[[canon]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga]]'', JA189's TIE fighter appears in the mission "Never Tell Me the Odds," in which it pursues the ''Falcon''''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga]]'' as in the film, but can then be shot down by the player once in the asteroid field rather then colliding with an asteroid. ==Appearances== *''[[Lost Stars]]'' {{Ab|Lost Stars (audiobook)}} {{1stID|JA189}} {{Voice}} *[[Lost Stars (webcomic)|''Lost Stars'' webcomic]] {{C|Starfighter only}} *{{Film|V}} {{1st}} {{C|Starfighter only}} *''[[The Empire Strikes Back: So You Want to Be a Jedi?]]'' {{Ab|The Empire Strikes Back: So You Want to Be a Jedi?
